answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 7661 Country: United Kingdom Title: Asalamualaykum 1-a-A Female has rubber Coil taken out of Vagina by a Male or Female Doctor with rubber gloves on when Fasting, will Fast break? b-If Fast breaks what is the reason 2-When taking out the rubber Coil from Vagina if blood comes out of Vagina will Fast break? 3-When taking out the rubber Coil from Vagina if white fluid comes out will Fast break? 4-a-Female has rubber Coil inserted in the Vagina by a Doctor will Fast break? b-If it breaks then what is the reason? Question: Asalamualaykum 1-a-A Female has rubber Coil taken out of Vagina by a Male or Female Doctor with rubber gloves on when Fasting, will Fast break? b-If Fast breaks what is the reason 2-When taking out the rubber Coil from Vagina if blood comes out of Vagina will Fast break? 3-When taking out the rubber Coil from Vagina if white fluid comes out will Fast break? 4-a-Female has rubber Coil inserted in the Vagina by a Doctor will Fast break? b-If it breaks then what is the reason? Answer ID: 7661 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1840/278=B/1429) (1, 2) It is mentioned in Fatawa Alamgiri: و ل و أدخل إصبعه في إسته والمرأة في فرجها لايفسد و هو المختار إلا اذا كانت مبتلة بالماء أو الدهن فحينئذ يفسد لوصول الماء والدهن It means that if the glove is dry and there is no water or oil or wetness on it, fast will not be broken if the rubber coil is taken out of vagina. (3-4) Fast will not be broken. (5) In this case, fast will be broken, this is alike putting medicine into the vagina. Rubber coil is also inserted for the purpose of medicine and treatment. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
